Final report updated with that result and the claim-check corrections; log gained D63, DN50, DN51. Recovery doc rewrite is at 457 lines with its verifier still running, so that file stays uncommitted.
Findings: A nested headless claude session authenticates and runs from inside a controller Claude Code session once the CLAUDECODE* environment variables are unset — settles two unknowns for the deferred trial; The real-host suite does not exercise compaction or resume, so the compaction defect (SessionStart compact injects only the delta) remains shown only through the hook shim
